concepts.name: Full-Stack Platform Chart
concepts.summary: Umbrella Helm chart deploying the entire ORISO platform on Kubernetes: Keycloak, MariaDB, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Redis, Matrix/Synapse, LiveKit, and all backend/frontend services as subcharts under charts/.

concepts.name: Config/Secret Split (values.yaml + secrets.yaml)
concepts.summary: Configuration is split across two gitignored files created from templates before deploying: values.yaml (domain, realm, Matrix server name) and secrets.yaml (all credentials). Only the *.default templates are tracked.

concepts.name: Keycloak Subchart & Custom Theme
concepts.summary: charts/keycloak carries the realm definition (realm.json), deployment templates, and the ORISO custom theme (login + OTP email templates, DE/EN messages, Nunito fonts) mounted via theme configmaps. restore-keycloak-settings.sh reapplies settings after redeploys.

concepts.name: MariaDB Subchart & SQL Schemas
concepts.summary: charts/mariadb ships per-service SQL schemas (agencyservice, consultingtypeservice, tenantservice, uploadservice, userservice) applied at provisioning time — the services themselves run with Liquibase disabled (see ORISO-Database).

concepts.name: Deployment Authority: dev only (NOT pre-dev)
concepts.summary: OPERATIONAL WARNING: the pre-dev environment still runs the legacy ORISO-Kubernetes chart; ORISO-Helm has never deployed pre-dev. Running helm upgrade against pre-dev is destructive (first-deploy semantics). Deployment-authority cleanup is tracked in ORISO-Helm issue #149.

concepts.name: Chart Release Workflow
concepts.summary: GitHub Actions workflow packaging and releasing the Helm chart (release-helm-chart.yml).

flows.name: Deploy Platform
flows.summary: Copy values.yaml.default → values.yaml and secrets.yaml.default → secrets.yaml, fill in domain/realm/credentials → helm install/upgrade the umbrella chart → subcharts provision Keycloak (realm + theme), databases (schemas), messaging, Matrix, LiveKit, and the ORISO services.

flows.name: Release Chart
flows.summary: Chart changes merged → release-helm-chart.yml packages and publishes the chart release.
